goVersion: go1.25.5 (upstream minimum); CI go1.26.3; exact builder recorded in out/MANIFEST.json
embeddingChoice: libtailscale C shared library + JNI, not gomobile AAR, not VpnService

overlay.purpose: Use getifaddrs directly so Android app SELinux never reaches netlink route sockets; initialize TS_LOGS_DIR to the app-private state directory before tsnet starts; expose a context-bounded dial entry point.
overlay.exit: Delete when upstream PR 19455 or tsnet rework lands in the pinned libtailscale.

interactiveLogin.authKey: not used; no reusable auth key is embedded

productPatch.purpose: Disable tsnet UserLogf so AuthURL is never printed by the default logger; backend Logf is separately discarded through the C API.
